typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 9 / big.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 9 / page.

recognitionRules: Use the orbital-reel cover motif to introduce a connected model, not a funnel.
Use the dark navy orbital-reel cover with light Futura titles; retain the separate warm-paper reading field in model layouts.
Keep each model question linked back to the central What must be true prompt.
Separate illustrative assumptions from commercial commitments.

principles: Let a concrete image or material action carry the opening; explain the work plainly afterward.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: A good idea needs a workable orbit: offer, time, cost and delivery.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid abstract manifestos that displace the actual work.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Begin with one thing you can make or inspect.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use ORBIT STORY STUDIO in Futura with an open orbital arc and one offset node. Avoid a planetary globe; the arc represents connected working questions.
invariants: Use the orbital-reel cover motif to introduce a connected model, not a funnel.
Use the dark navy orbital-reel cover with light Futura titles; retain the separate warm-paper reading field in model layouts.
Keep each model question linked back to the central What must be true prompt.
adaptations: Use the complete orbit on a model map and a partial arc on proposals.
Keep the economic assumptions readable without animation.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Futura is an Apple/system or separately licensed font; not bundled.
Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: One satellite-node radius around the complete symbol or lockup, measured from the outermost arc.

minimumSize.status: Conservative production recommendation after inspection at primary220px, secondary180px and symbols32/64px. Trial Ledger record code and Orbit descriptor motivate larger full-lockup minima; use secondary in narrow spaces.
